name: Amamiya Haruna
source: A kind third-year student who is also the landlord of dormitory which [url=/c37509]Touma[/url] moved into. Despite being a student, she is married to Touma's [url=/c37379]father[/url]. However soon after they got married, he left the dormitory and as such she manages it all on her own.
translation: A kind third-year student who is also the landlord of dormitory which [url=/c37509]Touma[/url] moved into. Despite being a student, she is married to Touma's [url=/c37379]father[/url].
